name: stage_failed_b
about: Harness self-test, the second of a pair: run after `stage_failed_a` in the same boot (path order), whose stage world went Failed. This record must stage over it, activate and pass: the relay's Trigger, fired at t=0.5, is seen. Reported as `error`, a failed stage still poisons the records behind it (H1). `stage_failed_a` ends `error` by design, so it is parked (`stage_failed_a.json.parked`) to keep the suite's self-tests green: restore the `.json` to run the pair (`uv run elysium arena stage_failed_a stage_failed_b`; wave H ran it 2026-10-04: a error, b pass).
